about_the_game:
Make Your Garden Flourish

Enjoy a mindful landscape while tending to your homemade garden. Grow, prune, and harvest flowers in a delightful grid-based game of logic, luck, and pattern recognition.

Thoughtfully balance probability and chance as flowers bloom at random. Test your skills and explore new strategies as you prune your garden to ensure it has no two of the same flower in any row, column, or quadrant. Master new challenges presented in each round as you watch your garden flourish!

Primrows is intentionally designed to be calming without compromising on challenge. With no time pressure, you’re free to curl up, relax, and carefully consider each gardening choice at your own pace.

Fresh Ways to Play & Weekly Challenges

Harvest as many points as you can in Quick Play or enjoy the more advanced Journal Play that rewards you for meeting certain criteria.

Can’t get enough? Anticipate each Weekly Challenge that introduces special flowers and tiles that change the gameplay. Celebrate holidays and other milestones with themed challenges and festive artwork to get you in the spirit of the season.

A Mindful, Serene Escape

Primrows combines familiar mechanics in new and unexpected ways, offering a fresh and cozy gameplay experience. Refine and hone your strategy, while mastering your skills and enjoying an outdoor escape.

With a high skill ceiling and plenty of depth, gameplay offers a challenging yet serene and approachable experience.

Handcrafted with ambient music and calming backgrounds, Primrows invites you to enjoy a relaxing experience.

  • Unwind with Quick Play or enjoy deep strategy with Journal Play

  • Weekly challenges to expand your gardening expertise

  • Immersive ambient soundscape inspired by nature

  • Cheerful artwork that changes with the seasons

  • Infinitely replayable with a high skill ceiling

  • Balance strategy, chance, and pattern recognition with no time pressure

  • Digestible for players of all skill levels

  • Accessibility for color blindness and low vision

short_description: A mindful game of logic, luck, and pattern recognition that adds a dice-rolling twist to sudoku rules. Grow, prune, and harvest flowers as you unwind with ambient soundscapes and scenery in each season. Unearth new challenges with special mechanics every week.
